entries.name: Suez Canal
entries.status: 63% of Far East–Europe capacity back on Red Sea services (Alphaliner, mid-Oct 2026); east-to-west Suez share ~18.7% vs ~80% pre-disruption; carriers run mixed routing.

entries.name: Bab el-Mandeb
entries.status: Houthi threat zone; all USV attacks within 70nm of Hodeidah. Nov 2 2026: airstrikes reported on Ras Isa oil port incl. a docked commercial vessel.

entries.name: Strait of Hormuz
entries.status: Disrupted since Feb 28 2026 US/Israeli strikes on Iran; Brent ~$100/bbl; emergency fuel + war-risk surcharges.

entries.name: Panama Canal
entries.status: El Niño drought: 33 daily slots (was 32), draft 49ft. Long-term slot auctions Nov 17/24 2026 for Jan–Apr 2027.

entries.name: Strait of Magellan
entries.status: Traffic +70% YoY Aug–Sep 2026 as Panama restrictions diverted ships south.

entries.name: Cape of Good Hope
entries.status: Long diversion (~10–14 days vs Suez); still heavily used, incl. eastbound legs of mixed-routing services.

entries.name: Shanghai
entries.status: 130+ vessels queued with Ningbo; ~860k TEU stuck; waits up to 2.7 days.

entries.name: Ningbo
entries.status: Queued with Shanghai; blank sailings concentrated on Ningbo/Shanghai/Qingdao through Oct 2026.

entries.name: Singapore
entries.status: Daily queue 12→22 ships in Sep 2026; 3.1-day waits.

entries.name: Colombo
entries.status: Congestion hotspot in the Indian Subcontinent.

meta.caveat: Statuses are a dated snapshot as of 2026-11-02 — verify before operational use. This is reference data, not a live feed.
meta.provenance: Curated 2026-11-02 from maritime press (Alphaliner, Journal of Commerce, gCaptain, Xeneta, C.H. Robinson, Splash247) for the OSTARA marine-traffic briefing.
meta.scope: Major maritime chokepoints and currently congested container ports. Locations are static reference points; statuses are a dated snapshot.
